ICS 75.120PCD 25Revised Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPEThis standard prescribes the requirements and methods of sampling and test for non-petroleum type heavy duty automotive hydraulic brake fluid for use in hydraulic brake systems fitted with drum, disc or either type of brakes at wide ambient temperatures. These fluids are designed for use in braking systems fitted with rubber cups and seals made from styrene butadiene rubber (SBR).2. REFERENCESThe following Indian Standards contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards indicated below:323 : 2009 Rectified spirit for industrial use (second revision)410 : 1977 Cold rolled brass sheet, strip and foil (third revision)737 : 2008 Wrought aluminium and aluminium alloy sheet and strip for general engineering purposes ( fourth revision)1070 : 1992 Reagent grade water (third revision)1447 (Part 1) : 2000 Petroleum and its products — Methods of sampling: Part 1 Manual sampling ( first revision )1448 Methods of test for petroleum and its products[P : 25/Sec 1] : 2018/ISO 3104 : 1994 Determination of kinematic and dynamic viscosity ( first revision)[P : 41] : 2019/ISO 9030 : 1990 Water and sediment in crude oils and fuel oils by centrifuge (second revision)1570 Schedules for wrought steels[P : 1] : 1978 Part 1 : Steels specified by tensile and/or yield properties ( first revision)2362 : 1993 Determination of water by karl fischer method — Test method (second revision)2631 : 1976 iso-Propyl alcohol ( first revision)3355 : 1974 Grey iron castings for elevated temperatures for non-pressure containing parts ( first revision)3400 [P : 2] : 2014/ISO 48 : 2010 Methods of test for vulcanized rubbers: Part 2 Hardness (second revision)14811 : 2000 Rolled copper plate, sheet, strip and foils for general engineering purposes
